map.Unicode 码点用 U+ 加十六进制表示；基本多文种平面（BMP）为 U+0: Unicode code points use U+ followed by hex; the Basic Multilingual Plane (BMP) is U+0000–U+FFFF, and emoji mostly sit in supplementary planes (e.g., 🚀 = U+1F680).
map.UTF-16 转义 \\uXXXX 仅覆盖 BMP；辅助平面字符需代理对（两个: UTF-16 escape \uXXXX covers only the BMP; supplementary-plane characters need surrogate pairs (two \u sequences).

map.超过 U+FFFF 的字符（如 Emoji）在 UTF-16 中用两个 16 位: Characters above U+FFFF (e.g., emoji) are represented in UTF-16 by two 16-bit units, i.e., a surrogate pair.
map.为什么一个 emoji 有两个码点？: Why does one emoji have two code points?
map.因为该字符位于辅助平面（码点 > U+FFFF），UTF-16 需用两个 16: Because the character is in a supplementary plane (code point > U+FFFF), UTF-16 needs two 16-bit units (a surrogate pair); moreover, some emoji are composed of multiple code points (skin-tone modifiers, flags from two regional indicators, family emoji from several people joined by ZWJ). So "one character" is not necessarily "one code point".
